title: Validate: Cross-check Epoch Increment oracle
description: Run oracle against existing vectors if any. Compare with RFC examples. Verify all MUST statements covered.
close_reason: Epoch Increment oracle cross-checked. Gap found and fixed: existing epoch_rollover.json tests only verified vector self-consistency; the real Python oracle never ran through them. Added to python/tests/test_vectors.py: test_epoch_rollover_sender_sequence_oracle (parametrized, drives ReplayWindow through sender sequences incl. terminal-counter no-wrap assertion) and test_epoch_rollover_receiver_state_oracle (seeds receiver state via public API, reconstructs duplicate_in_window bitmap precondition against recorded window bits, asserts decisions for all 9 receiver vectors). Rust parity already landed in shared_vectors.rs::test_epoch_rollover_vectors. RFC comparison: spec 4.4 deliberately diverges from RFC 4303 ESP anti-replay and does NOT use RFC 1982 serial-number arithmetic; counter_comparison_unsigned is the executable proof of unsigned ordering. All MUST statements mapped mechanically in test_spec_44_must_coverage_map.
